# Code Of Conduct

A Code of Conduct is a formal set of guidelines that outlines ethical standards, behavioral expectations, and legal compliance for individuals within KLP. It aims to ensure a respectful, inclusive, and safe environment while aligning with the organization's core values. The Code covers aspects such as professional behavior, legal obligations, conflict resolution and specifies consequences for violations. It also promotes transparency, accountability, and risk mitigation, while fostering trust and a positive organizational culture. Regular reviews from CODEOWNERS ensure its relevance and effectiveness.

# Pull Request Template
  
* Create a pull request with pull request template.

* Add Description for the reason of the push request.

* If the push request is created because of an issue then add screenshot off the issue and add the right information to the pull request template.

* All pull request that will make changes on production environment should refer to a jira ticket or change number.

# Configure codeowners

* Your github repo must have assigned codeowners to use approvals in pull requests. This feature is set in branch protection configuration.

# Branch protection

* For development branches in GitHub repository, it's not necessary to use branch protection. In production branches we recommend using branch protection. This will prevent any mistake with production code and will also encourage the team to collaborate with the code.

Documentation for Code Of Conduct and how-to guides:  [Code Of Conduct](https://confluence.klp.no/display/KAO/Code+Of+Conduct).
